admitted_inherited: PR #1132 exact committed receipt derived publication
scope: Source-backed physical crop lifecycle handoff contract only; no new physical behavior admitted
transition_order: At accepted time boundary: independently validate preflight and source calendar; do not mutate committed physical crop or lifecycle flags
Create candidate on clone of current committed crop-owner state; source-specific preparation/sowing/germination decisions use declared hydraulic/thermal values and documented precedence
Never infer emergence merely from calendar ENTER: emergence requires validated preparation, sowing, germination and corresponding source conditions
At accepted emergence initialize new crop owner and root extraction consistently; at accepted harvest handle crop teardown/reset once
Publish crop-owner revision and associated calendar/receipt lifecycle only following one matching accepted F-KT event; reject/retry must leave original owner, calendar and window unchanged
Persist a single coherent physical crop identity, lifecycle flags, calendar checkpoint and consumed-event lineage for restart; reconstruct and validate before resuming

source_constraints.calendar_sequence: Following crop begins >=0.5 source day after former crop end
source_constraints.season_initialization: Simulation start inside existing growing season requires SWINCO=3 compatibility branch
source_constraints.source_tolerances: 0.1 day active crop selection, 0.001 day exact cropstart flag; not proof of arbitrary scheduler rounding
source_constraints.physical_inputs: Hydraulic pressure head, soil temperature and workability owner to be reconciled before sowing/germination binding

invariants: F-KT is sole physical commit owner
Reject/retry cannot modify committed crop state, crop flags, calendar, accepted window or consumed receipt
Do not reopen accepted root-uptake, MICRO, transport or hydraulic state interfaces without respective owning workstream reconciliation
Restart after accepted event has exactly same following crop identity, owner state and event consumption
No double harvest, double sow, duplicated physical evolution or repeated root initialization on replay
test_matrix: start within season and SWINCO rejection/acceptance
preparation, sowing and germination gated by frozen physical forcing
delayed emergence and later root initialization
rejected and retried physical trial zero mutation
stale revision and mismatched committed receipt fail closed
checkpoint restart before and after each boundary reproduces successor
next_action: Implement isolated pure preflight evaluation of typed, explicitly provided preparation/sowing/temperature status as source-conditional candidate only, or first establish missing aggregate forcing and restart owner; no direct F-KT mutation or lifecycle flag persistence until contract is reconciled.

reconciled_current_owner.physical_crop_state: src/runtime/mod_fmr_wofost_crop_transaction.f90: fmr_wofost_crop_transaction_state_t owns crop owner, optional potential shadow/root growth and last consumed event
reconciled_current_owner.physical_persistence: fmr_wofost_crop_transaction_persistence_t carries owner/optional shadows/root growth/last receipt but not calendar or lifecycle prep/sow/germination flags
reconciled_current_owner.source_forcing_gap: fmr_wofost_crop_event_forcing_t carries accepted crop daily forcing/event identity, not the B1.11 h_average(zprep/zsow/zgerm), nodsow soil temperature, tav, or SWHEA eligibility as typed lifecycle inputs
reconciled_current_owner.current_owner_boundary: wofost_crop_owner_state_t is transaction state, crop emergence/phenology; a separate mutable physical lifecycle owner must not be invented or published from a preflight decision

source_condition_details.preparation: swprep=0 defaults done at start; swprep=1 checks h_average(zprep)-hprep > 0; delay increments and postpones until maxprepdelay, else progresses
source_condition_details.sowing: swsow=0 defaults done at start; swsow=1 requires SWHEA=1; checks tsoil(nodsow)<tempsow OR h_average(zsow)-hsow>0, delayed to maxsowdelay; delay_sow starts from delay_prep
source_condition_details.germination: swgerm=0 defaults done; swgerm=1 temperature sum; swgerm=2 adds pressure-head-dependent tsumemesub and weather tav; tsumgerm advances once per source day, must not advance on rejected trial
source_condition_details.ordering: Crop emergence requires fl_prep AND fl_sow AND fl_germ after previous-day check; initialization and daily progression have distinct task modes. On source cropstart flags reset, but that does not authorize direct physical SWAP5 mutation.
